The Roubic Chagrin Falls Story

Heritage-Canopy Work Since 1982

Chagrin Falls has been part of Roubic's regular rotation for more than four decades — a flagship village just a few miles from our Auburn Township yard. The trees that make Chagrin Falls look like Chagrin Falls — heritage oaks, mature maples, ash carrying EAB risk, and original-growth pines — are exactly the trees we work on.

The village context matters: a historic core straddling the Chagrin River, ravine geography that limits equipment access on many properties, and older architecture that puts trees close to structures. We know which streets the village allows access on, which homes sit on conservation easements, and which blocks fall under tree-protection review. {{global.owner_name}} personally walks every Chagrin Falls estimate.

The tree care has to fit the place. In Chagrin Falls that means respecting the canopy, the river, and the neighbors — which is why I still walk every estimate. {{global.owner_name}} · Owner

Common Chagrin Falls Questions

Chagrin Falls Tree Service FAQ

Six things Chagrin Falls homeowners want to know before booking.

Do you serve Chagrin Falls, OH?
Yes. Chagrin Falls is part of Roubic Tree & Landscape's Tier 1 flagship service area, just a few miles from our Auburn Township yard. We've served Chagrin Falls since 1982. Call {{global.phone}} for a free estimate.
How quickly can Roubic respond in Chagrin Falls?
Tier 1 markets like Chagrin Falls receive priority estimate scheduling from our Auburn Township yard. For 24/7 storm emergencies, call our emergency line — we aim to be on-site within 2–4 hours inside the primary service area.
Do I need a tree-removal permit in Chagrin Falls?
Chagrin Falls has an active Shade Tree Commission and a village tree ordinance that requires a permit for healthy-tree removal above a specified DBH threshold; hazard trees follow an expedited process. Roubic coordinates the permit workflow on your behalf as part of the estimate scope.
How much does tree removal cost in Chagrin Falls?
Tree removal in Chagrin Falls typically runs $200–$10,000+ depending on size, species, access, and permit fees. Small trees under 20 ft start at $200–$500; mature 50–80 ft trees run $1,500–$3,500; very large heritage estate trees needing crane assistance can exceed $10,000. Every estimate is free and confirmed on-site.
What tree services are available in Chagrin Falls?
Roubic offers tree removal, tree trimming & pruning, stump grinding, land clearing, storm damage & emergency care, and firewood delivery in Chagrin Falls. Click any service card above for pricing and process details.
Is Roubic licensed and insured to work in Chagrin Falls?
Yes — Roubic is a family-owned company operating since 1982 and carries general liability and workers-comp insurance. A certificate of insurance is available on request and included in the estimate packet for jobs requiring COI submission.
